title: Paw Print Portal
description: A glowing spherical orb containing a black paw print floats above an ornate green crown on a wooden table, emitting electric sparks and surrounded by floating paw prints. A dark ornate sword with glowing orange paw prints on its hilt is embedded in the table, dripping black liquid with white floral patterns.
prompt: Surreal night scene on a wooden table, a glowing white orb with a large black paw print inside floats above an ornate teal crown decorated with glowing flowers and fireflies, electric sparks radiate outward, floating paw prints drift in the dark sky, a dark sword covered in white floral patterns and glowing orange paw prints is stabbed into the table with black liquid dripping from it, lush ferns below, mysterious and magical atmosphere, detailed digital painting
